title: GCP-7.1: add replay-window bitmap to handoff confirm payload (spec amendment)
description: Design amendment for l1qw.23.1 (lost to bd8h): the GCP-7.1 handoff confirm payload currently transfers only (link_epoch u8, link_seq u16) — but the link replay window is a 32-bit bitmap (bit 0 = last_seq, bit i = last_seq - i; lichen/subsys/lichen/link/replay.h) tracking in-window gaps the old gateway already accepted. With only the floor, the new gateway re-accepts frames in those gaps: a replay hole exactly at handoff, the attack GCP-7.1 exists to prevent. Amendment: add confirm payload key 7 = replay_bitmap (u32, bit i = link_seq - i set when that sequence was accepted), plus receiver validation step 9a (MUST reconstruct the window from epoch/seq/bitmap; MUST reject bitmap 0x00000001-with-gap... precisely: bit 0 MUST be set since link_seq itself was accepted). Deliverable: spec/08-gateway-coordination.md table row + CBOR example + validation step. Implementations follow separately.
close_reason: GCP-7.1 replay-window bitmap spec amendment landed in spec/08-gateway-coordination.md. THE HOLE: the handoff confirm transferred only (link_epoch, link_seq) — a floor. The link replay window is a 32-bit bitmap (bit 0 = link_seq, bit i = link_seq - i, lichen replay.h) tracking in-window gaps the old gateway already accepted; floor-only transfer would re-accept frames in those gaps exactly at handoff — the attack GCP-7.1 exists to prevent. Amendment: (1) confirm payload key 7 = replay_bitmap (u32, bit i = link_seq - i, set = already accepted) in the table + CBOR example; (2) validation step 8 rejects bitmap > 32 bits or bit 0 clear (bit 0 MUST be set — link_seq itself was accepted); (3) step 9 reconstructs the window from epoch/seq/bitmap; (4) the acceptance rule now enumerates the exact lichen_replay_check semantics (newer epoch accept / stale reject / seq==link_seq reject / seq>link_seq accept+advance (no bitmap bit exists) / seq<link_seq accept only when offset<32 AND bit clear); (5) the Link-Layer Replay State Transfer section requires bitmap restore. Codereview 2x Kimi K3 to convergence: pass 1 found the substantive acceptance-rule mis-grouping (my rule referenced a negative-offset bitmap bit for seq>link_seq and omitted gap acceptance — over-rejection fail-closed but normatively inconsistent) plus the width-bound nit — both fixed; final pass PASS (no findings; adversarial-bitmap analysis bounded to over-rejection). Implementations (C/Rust/Python handoff) consume this amendment as separate work under l1qw.23. This bead also documents the lost l1qw.23.1 (bd8h full-record loss; its scope completed here).
